title: Why Mathematics? From Everyday Questions to Quantum Ideas
subtitle: The problems it solves, the ideas it connects, and your path through the course.
prerequisite_note: Basic arithmetic; unfamiliar algebra is explained as it appears.
objectives: Explain what several major branches of mathematics are for, in terms of the questions they answer.
Follow three small worked problems: a break-even comparison, a maximum area, and an instantaneous speed.
Distinguish a formula, a model, a proof and a calculation, and say what each can and cannot establish.
Explain why x^2 + 1 = 0 has no real solution and why that motivates complex numbers.
Choose a sensible starting route through the course.
